content.text: This References and Compliance Library consolidates all authoritative sources that underpin the policies, procedures, and practices outlined in this Principal's Handbook. The library serves multiple critical functions: For Regulatory Compliance: Provides direct access to Indonesian national education regulations, enabling schools to verify compliance with Ministry of Education requirements, Yayasan obligations, and national curriculum mandates. For Accreditation Readiness: Links to CIS and WASC standards documentation, supporting self-study preparation and evidence compilation for accreditation cycles. For Cambridge Centre Operations: References Cambridge International's official handbooks, guides, and policy documents essential for maintaining Centre status and examination integrity. For Professional Practice: Curates best-practice resources for English as an Extra Language (EAL), Special Educational Needs (SEN), and Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) implementation. For Evidence Management: The Reference Index (Appendix 20.1) tracks version numbers, update dates, and responsible officers to ensure schools maintain current documentation.

content.title: Note on this table
content.text: The source image listed a sixth row, "Category E: School Culture and Environment for Learning". ACS WASC International Focus on Learning (2017) defines four categories only, A to D. Category E does not exist and has been removed; its school-climate content is folded into Category C, where the 2017 framework places it.

content.title: ACS WASC framework — International Focus on Learning (2017)
rows: The complete WASC self-study process and framework. Note that "Focus on Learning" names the whole process, not a category within it.
Category A: Organization for Student Learning
Standards for governance and organizational effectiveness
Category B: Curriculum, Instruction, and Assessment
Category C: Support for Student Personal and Academic Growth
Standards for student support services, school climate and culture
Category D: Resource Management and Development

content.text: Two corrections to the source image. First, EASE was described as a single "Evaluation of Achievement Standardized Exam"; under the current model EASE is an umbrella brand with two applications. Second, the image listed the EduNav platform as the live quality-management dashboard and evidence repository. Confirm the current system of record before directing schools to it - if EduNav is a legacy product, every EduNav storage instruction in Sections 19 and 20 points at the wrong system.

content.title: Eduversal quality management system components
rows: Umbrella assessment brand covering EASE Growth (reasoning and literacy benchmark) and EASE Common Assessments (centralized chapter-end and semester-end subject tests).
Development of Teaching Proficiency programme structure and procedures, delivered by Educamp
Teacher and school appraisal systems and rubrics
